limitations: Reference racing trace, not surveyed road centerline/boundaries
Rigid full-lap registration evaluates shape, not absolute or online localization
Missing intervals stay unsupported; chord phase is reconstructed
Coarse supported curvature is a proxy; no surveyed curvature truth
Ten-lap sensitivity is descriptive, not calibrated confidence; two development circuits only
Official DRS, road width/elevation, surveyed centerline and full pit route UNKNOWN
Prior development-event reuse disclosed; reserved benchmarks untouched
No vehicle/world-model validation, production or R3 maturity promotion
Unsupported test anchors UNKNOWN; >=98% retained time span; errors conditional on optimized rigid pose
Source-only forward derivative QC; retrospective and additional same-event confirmation laps reported separately
